The browser's copy of apps/factory/config/models.json, plus `assess`, the model writing feedback uses (Phase 4 Slice 3; progress.md D103), and the oral practice turn loop's three (Phase 5 Slice 2, D117, human decision 27 September 2026): `transcribe` (gpt-transcribe, billed by the minute), `speech` (tts-1, billed by the character; both units the device measures, so the meter matches the bill) and `examiner` (the text model that writes each question). `voice` is the examiner's voice, not a model, so `roleModels` leaves it out.
